# Marker

Marker identifies a marker declaration within Blue Contracts. It extends `Contract` without adding fields or defining an executable action.

It inherits `order`, used for declaration ordering. The supplied evidence establishes no required value or default for this field.

Runtime-recognized protected markers are subject to contextual validation and integrity checks; forged protected markers are rejected on fresh input. This does not establish that every Marker has the same protection or records the same fact.

No marker-specific payload, trigger, or state meaning is defined here. A Marker alone does not establish that an operation succeeded or completed.
